name: 量子化フィンガープリント
description: Analyzes JPEG quantization table fingerprints. Camera images show characteristic quantization patterns while AI images lack standard compression signatures.
mechanism: Analyzes pixel value histograms for periodic patterns caused by JPEG quantization. Camera images show comb-like patterns.
parameters: Periods: 2-8, Metrics: comb ratio, periodic score
useCase: Identifying JPEG compression signatures from camera pipelines

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Farid, H. (2009). Exposing Digital Forgeries from JPEG Ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Lukáš, J. et al. (2006). Detecting Digital Image Forgeries Using Sensor Pattern Noise. SPIE.

strengths:
• Directly analyzes JPEG compression history
• Can identify specific compression software
• Reveals double compression and editing traces
• Standard quantization tables are well-documented
• Very fast analysis of DCT coefficients
limitations:
• Only applicable to JPEG format
• Custom quantization tables complicate analysis
• Quality factor estimation has inherent uncertainty
• Non-JPEG AI images bypass this analysis
• Re-encoding masks original quantization
